flows.title: Visitor explores property listings
flows.trigger: Visitor lands on homepage and scrolls to Property Showcase section
steps: Visitor sees horizontal scrolling gallery of featured properties
Visitor hovers over a property card to see full-color image
Visitor notes the price badge, property name, and location
Visitor contacts Aresphi via WhatsApp or email for more information
flows.outcome: Visitor has browsed available properties and initiated contact for promising listings

flows.title: Property owner submits inquiry
flows.trigger: Property owner wants to list their property with Aresphi
steps: Owner navigates to Kontak section via navigation or footer
Owner finds contact information (phone, email, WhatsApp)
Owner reaches out via mailto link or WhatsApp deep link
Aresphi team responds to schedule consultation
flows.outcome: Owner has initiated contact with Aresphi for property listing

flows.title: Investor learns about company credentials
flows.trigger: Investor wants to verify Aresphi's track record before engaging
steps: Investor scrolls to Stats Section (Pencapaian)
Investor reviews metrics: properties sold, satisfied clients, years experience, success rate
Investor scrolls to USP Section to understand differentiators
Investor reads testimonials from previous clients
flows.outcome: Investor has confidence in Aresphi's capabilities and credibility

flows.title: Business owner seeks commercial property
flows.trigger: Business owner needs ruko, gudang, or kantor space
steps: Business owner lands on homepage from search or referral
Owner scrolls through Hero section to understand services
Owner navigates to Layanan section to see service process
Owner contacts Aresphi via WhatsApp or email for commercial property needs
flows.outcome: Business owner has initiated contact for commercial property consultation

flows.title: Admin manages property catalog
flows.trigger: Aresphi agent acquires new property to list or needs to update existing listings
steps: Admin logs into property management dashboard using env-stored credentials
Admin uploads property photos to Vercel Blob via the dashboard
Admin enters property details (name, location, price, type, status)
Admin selects which photos appear in Hero, Property Showcase, and other sections
Property appears in designated sections on the public website
flows.outcome: Property catalog is updated and visible on website

flows.title: Admin updates company stats
flows.trigger: Marketing team wants to update achievement metrics
steps: Admin logs into dashboard
Admin navigates to Stats management section
Admin updates values for properties sold, clients, years, success rate
Stats Section on public website reflects new values
flows.outcome: Company achievements are kept current on the website

flows.title: Renter explores rental options
flows.trigger: Individual or family needs rental property
steps: Renter visits Aresphi website
Renter browses Property Showcase for rental listings (indicated by monthly price format)
Renter reviews Process Section to understand how Aresphi helps
Renter contacts Aresphi via WhatsApp for viewing appointment
flows.outcome: Renter has scheduled property viewing with Aresphi agent
